prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a pair of hands holding a student ID card in a natural, candid manner. The ID card is prominently displayed in the center of the frame, with the text "Midland Brooke University" and a green and white color scheme featuring a stylized university logo. The card includes a small, circular portrait of a young woman with short, light hair and a neutral expression, labeled "Jemma Miller." The hands are gently gripping the edges of the card, with soft, natural lighting illuminating the scene and creating subtle highlights on the skin and plastic surface of the ID. The background is softly blurred, suggesting the interior of a vehicle or a subdued, out-of-focus environment, enhancing the sense of intimacy and focus on the card. The overall color palette is muted and realistic, with earthy tones and a slight cinematic grain, evoking a sense of authenticity and quiet introspection. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to draw attention to the details of the ID card and the hands, while the camera angle is slightly above and to the side, creating a documentary or film still aesthetic.
